pages.text: Right-click a camper to go inside: $(l)cupboards$() for your things, a $(l)stove$() that cooks food as a smoker does (only while it's parked), and a $(l)Sleep$() button.
Food on top, fuel underneath, and what's cooked on the right.

$(l)Sleeping$() works like a bed: it sets your spawn outside the door, and once enough players are asleep the night passes. Only in a parked camper, at night, with no monsters close by. Each camper sleeps two; you wake outside.
Parked, the camp unfolds: awning, lights, steps, jacks, and chairs to sit in.
At night the lights and the windows glow. Hitch it and everything folds away.
